tw.headline: Sika ahe na wo sotɔɔ nyae ɛnnɛ?
tw.support: Sɛ wonnim a, wo sika reyera.
tw.say: Sika ahe na wo sotɔɔ nyae ɛnnɛ? Sɛ wonnim a, wo sika reyera.

tw.headline: Wunim eyi?
tw.say: Nwoma no yera. Wo werɛ fi adetɔfo ka. Sika a ɛwɔ nsam ne mobaa mɔni di afra.

tw.headline: Azaria
tw.say: Hyia Asaria. Kyerɛw ɛnnɛ. Nyin ɔkyena.

tw.headline: Hu wo sika nyinaa wɔ baabi koro.
tw.say: Hu wo sika nyinaa wɔ baabi koro. Sika a ɛwɔ nsam, mobaa mɔni, ne sikakorabea.

tw.headline: Kyerɛw adetɔn ntɛm ara.
tw.say: Kyerɛw adetɔn ntɛm ara, na ma adetɔn ne ɛka ntetew mu.

tw.headline: Biribiara, da biara.
tw.say: Hu biribiara a wokyerɛwee, da biara. Sika a aba, ne sika a akɔ.

tw.headline: Hu wɔn a wɔde wo ka.
tw.say: Hu wɔn a wɔde wo ka pɛpɛɛpɛ, na soma nkaebɔ ntɛm.

tw.headline: Amanneɛbɔ sɛ PDF anaa Excel.
tw.say: Nya amanneɛbɔ a emu da hɔ, sɛ pi di ɛf, anaa ɛksɛl.

tw.headline: Wɔyɛ maa wo adwuma.
points: Ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ
tw.say: Ɛyɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ mpo, na wo nsɛm yɛ kokoam.

tw.headline: Hu wo adwuma. Ma wo adwuma nyin.
tw.say: Hu wo adwuma. Ma wo adwuma nyin. Fi ase ne Asaria ɛnnɛ.
